# demo error reference

> One page per error. Each page gives the cause and the fix for that > error code.

## Errors

- [E1001: Input arrays have different lengths](https://yourname.github.io/demo/errors/E1001.md): x and y came from different sources, or only one of them was filtered.
- [E1002: Config file not found](https://yourname.github.io/demo/errors/E1002.md): The path passed to load() does not exist, or is relative to a different directory.
